label: Instance terminals and block terminals
subgoals: Multiply each master's instance count by its signal pins
Sum the products to get the ITerm count
Count block ports separately as BTerms

label: Nets as hyperedges of terminals
subgoals: Add connected ITerms and BTerms to get net connections
Divide the connections by the number of nets
Separate the high-fanout nets the average hides

label: Expanding nets into graphs
subgoals: Compute p(p-1)/2 clique edges for each p-terminal net
Sum the edges over all nets
Compare with the p entries of the hyperedge or star form
